newsitem.title: USA: American Air, China Eastern in code-sharing pact.
newsitem.headline: American Air, China Eastern in code-sharing pact.

text.p: American Airlines and China Eastern Airlines Corp Ltd said Wednesday they had signed a memorandum of understanding to create reciprocal code-sharing programs between American's service points in the U.S. and China Eastern's gateways of Beijing and Shanghai. A formal filing for regulatory approval is to follow, they said.
The two airlines said the code-sharing programs will provide passengers with improved connections between their services in Los Angeles and San Francisco.
American Air is a unit of AMR Corp.
